rubric_items.reason: Job, service, repo, migration (via DB), list/patient/doctor/dashboard, label and page are tested for all of S-1 to S-5 and S-7; only the server.ts start/stop wiring has no test.
Assertions check observable results: statuses, history event and actor, list ids, HTTP 400/409 and field errors, badge text and class, button states, picker date.
Error paths (unknown filter, missing reason, closed 409, past move, job failure) and edges (09:59/10:01, future, rerun, stop) are covered; the exact 24h boundary is not.
Vitest+Supertest with own DB and pgAvailable skip, Vitest+Testing Library for web, files beside existing tests, names follow the HMS-3 precedent.
No invented numbers; results deferred to checks.json, where tests pass and coverage is skipped (exit 78) as the artifact states.
